'''Porinju Veliyath''' (born 6 June 1962) is an Indian [[investor]] and fund manager.<ref>{{cite web|title=The secret sauce of smart investing|url=http://www.forbesindia.com/column/column/the-secret-sauce-of-smart-investing/40535/1|website=www.forbesindia.com|publisher=Forbesindia.com|accessdate=9 July 2017}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Wealth wizards: Follow the 'keep it simple' policy for investments|url=http://www.forbesindia.com/article/boardroom/wealth-wizards-follow-the-keep-it-simple-policy-for-investments/40603/1|website=www.forbesindia.com/|publisher=Forbesindia.com|accessdate=8 July 2017}}</ref> He manages his own portfolio and the portfolios of investors in his fund management firm ''Equity Intelligence India Private Limited''. He has been called a small-cap [[czar]] by ''[[The Economic Times]]''.<ref>{{cite news|title=Inside Porinju Veliyath's portfolio: Top stocks that helped this maverick make 42% return |url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/inside-porinju-veliyaths-portfolio-top-stocks-that-helped-this-maverick-make-42-return/articleshow/57935843.cms|newspaper=The Economic Times|date=31 March 2017 |accessdate=8 July 2017 |last1=Mudgill |first1=Amit }}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Porinju Veliyath's firm buys 4 lakh shares in Archies, shares surge |url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/porinju-veliyaths-firm-buys-4-lakh-shares-in-archies-shares-surge/articleshow/58121412.cms|newspaper=The Economic Times|date=11 April 2017 |accessdate=8 July 2017}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Porinju's Equity Intelligence buys 1 lakh shares in Shalimar Paints; stock surges |url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/porinju-veliyaths-firm-buys-1-lakh-shares-of-shalimar-paints-shares-surge/articleshow/58273385.cms|newspaper=The Economic Times|date=20 April 2017 |accessdate=8 July 2017}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Staking it high in the stock markets|url=http://www.newindianexpress.com/cities/kochi/2017/jun/24/staking-it-high-in-the-stock-markets-1620192--1.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170627041313/http://www.newindianexpress.com/cities/kochi/2017/jun/24/staking-it-high-in-the-stock-markets-1620192--1.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=27 June 2017|website=www.newindianexpress.com|publisher=New Indian Express|accessdate=8 July 2017}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Archies stock on fire as Porinju buys stake amid turnaround news|url=http://www.financialexpress.com/market/archies-stock-on-fire-as-porinju-buys-stake-amid-turnaround-news/624370/|website=www.financialexpress.com|date=11 April 2017 |publisher=The Indian Express [P] Ltd.|accessdate=9 July 2017}}</ref>

== Early life ==
Porinju was born in a lower-middle-class family<ref>{{cite web |title=Porinju Veliyath's Early Life, Success Story And Latest Portfolio |url=https://www.niveza.in/stock-news/porinju-veliyath/porinju-veliyaths-latest-portfolio-holdings-news-march |website=niveza.in |publisher=Niveza Editorial Desk |accessdate=14 May 2019}}</ref> in Chalakudy village, Thrissur near to [[Kochi]] city and [[Athirappilly Falls]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Too much market information is not always good: Porinju Veliyath |url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/opinion/interviews/too-much-market-information-is-not-always-good-porinju-veliyath/articleshow/49780173.cms|newspaper=The Economic Times|date=14 November 2015 |publisher=Bennett, Coleman & Co. Ltd.}}</ref>

== Career ==
Porinju Veliyath started his career in Mumbai as a floor trader with [[Kotak Securities]] in 1990.<ref name=":0">{{cite web|url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/life/2003/07/28/stories/2003072800110200.htm|title=Equity relaxes him|date=28 July 2003|website=www.thehindubusinessline.com|publisher=The Hindu Business Line|accessdate=8 January 2018}}</ref> Later he joined Parag Parikh Securities in 1994 where he worked as research analyst and fund manager until 1999, when he moved back to Kochi.<ref name=":0" /> In 2002, he founded Equity Intelligence, a fund management firm focused on [[Value investing|Value Investing]] in Indian Equites.

He is also a director with Arya Vaidya Pharmacy, which with [[Hindustan Unilever Limited]] (HUL) has created a range of [[Ayurveda|Ayurvedic]] personal care products under the 'Lever Ayush' brand.

Porinju Veliyath expresses his views and ideas on Value Investing and opines on current affairs actively on [[Twitter]] and has over 1,000,000 followers.<ref name="auto">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/porinju|title=Porinju Veliyath|website=Twitter|accessdate=8 January 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Staking it high in the stock markets|url=http://www.newindianexpress.com/cities/kochi/2017/jun/24/staking-it-high-in-the-stock-markets-1620192--1.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170627041313/http://www.newindianexpress.com/cities/kochi/2017/jun/24/staking-it-high-in-the-stock-markets-1620192--1.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=27 June 2017|accessdate=8 January 2018|publisher=newindianexpress.com}}</ref>
